_note: Twelve synthetic help-desk messages for Belgavi's Book Store with hand-written gold labels. Author: Sandeep Belgavi.

cases.text: Hi, order BK-40211 arrived with a torn cover on the atlas. I'd like a replacement please.
Where is my parcel? It was due Monday. Order number BK-40388.
Please refund the 649 rupees for the cookbook, I cancelled before it shipped. BK-40412
I want to send back two novels from order BK-40450, they are not what I expected.
Can you change the delivery address for BK-40501 to my office? Same city.
This is the third time I am writing. Let me talk to a human about my missing refund of Rs 1,250.
Do you have the new Tamil translation of the poetry anthology in stock?
My order bk 40622 came with pages 40 to 72 missing. Very disappointed.
Two weeks and still nothing. Order BK-40705. I paid 899. Please get someone to call me.
I returned the dictionary last week (BK-40733) but have not seen the 1499 back on my card.
Wrong book delivered for order BK-40790, I ordered volume 2 and got volume 1. I will return it.
Thanks for the quick help yesterday, everything is sorted now!
